launch_rules.quarterly: Two quarters before the quarter the forecast was published in: the last quarter of household income outturn it had.
launch_rules.calendar: The calendar year before the forecast was published.
launch_rules.fiscal: The last complete fiscal year (April to March) before the forecast was published.

left_out.why: Not the OBR's: this view shows the OBR's own forecasts.

left_out.what: Restated March 2019 and supplementary March 2020 forecasts (memo rows)
left_out.why: Restatements of forecasts already shown, not separate forecasts.

left_out.what: Individual taxes and spending lines (income tax, NICs, VAT, onshore corporation tax and some 50 others)
left_out.why: Not headline outcomes; each needs its own ONS outturn and the database warns that classifications change between forecasts.

left_out.what: Expenditure components of GDP (consumption, investment, trade, inventories), productivity, wages and salaries, GDP deflator, saving ratio, household net worth, current account, claimant count
left_out.why: Not headline outcomes in this pass.

left_out.what: Cyclically adjusted borrowing and current budget, output gap
left_out.why: Estimates of an unobserved cycle: there is no ONS outturn to set them against.
Forecast only since November 2016; its outturn as a share of GDP was not set up in this pass.

left_out.what: World and euro area GDP, world trade, UK export markets
Oil and gas prices, equity prices, Bank Rate, gilt rates, the exchange rate
left_out.why: Assumptions the OBR takes from market prices, not its own forecasts.

gaps: Real household disposable income per person: no economy tables with Table 1.5's per-person index were found for forecasts before November 2016, or for March 2018, November 2020 and October 2021.
